coverage_note: The published analysis lists per-model votes only for the cells where the three outputs differ by two points or more. The remaining votes exist in the per-model raw responses preserved on the host and have not been promoted into the corpus. Separately, three of the ten contested cells list only two votes while carrying no declined marker in the source table, so whether the third model declined or the analysis simply did not publish its vote cannot be told from the corpus alone; those are recorded as unrecorded_reason 'not-published' rather than inferred to be declines. Reading the raw responses on 2026-08-19 did not settle that, and showed why it cannot be settled mechanically: the published supply matrix has ten technique columns, but two of the three models answered on twelve, splitting the repo skills into `ste`, `plainspoken` and `humanize` and scoring each separately, while the third returned a single bundled column. Collapsing twelve columns into one `repo skills` column is a normalization step that no artifact records, and it is the step the three two-vote cells sit in. For Empathy x repo skills the published pair {-1, +1} is reproducible either as one model's compound answer or as two models' sub-column values; nothing in the corpus distinguishes them. See 04-normalized/corrections.md.
